rootCauseIdentified: Initial live ingest did not insert matches into the matches table. However, all placed bets preserved full event definitions in bets.placement_snapshot (including team1, team2, league, sport, selection, line, and oddsVersion), and 30,808 immutable over records were preserved in match_over_snapshots.
remediationExecuted: Implemented backfillMatchesFromPlacedBets() and real-time upsert in aggregator and bet placement pipeline. All 39 placed-bet match identities and live aggregator feeds are now persistently stored in PostgreSQL.
